behavioral_time_rule: Every behavioral source event is strictly before the snapshot cutoff; labels must be at or after it.
metadata_warning: Genre labels are not historically versioned. The optional genre group requires an explicit static-metadata assumption and is not certified historically available.
missing_values: Cold-user recency and relative popularity may be NULL. Any learned imputation/scaling must be fitted on training data only.
candidate_policy_warning: Historical movie observation is a conservative availability proxy, not an exposure or release log. Eligibility remains subject to Milestone 5's final protocol.
